meta.semantics: series[i] is the chart for the stats-vectors.json series case of the same name: 'kept' indexes its response points (line: those with a mean; stacked: those with answers); 'labelled' indexes 'kept' per chart width; labels are formatBucket(start) in 'tz'. stats[i] is the Overview for the stats case of the same name (dates in meta.summary_tz). activity[i] is activityStrip(captured_at, today, tz): cells [day, count, level] from first_day to today, 'from' the listEntries bound (first_day's local midnight, UTC). sparklines[i] is sparkline(points, width) for the stats-vectors.json series case of the same name, or its inline 'points'. timing_models[i] is stepsByBucket(series, bucket) for the timing-stats-vectors.json case of the same name, bucketed in 'tz'.
